More: how to use it, examples, and common errors

How to use it

  1. Paste a Markdown draft into the input area or load the sample.
  2. Render the document to update the preview and HTML output.
  3. Check heading hierarchy, fenced code blocks, links, and list indentation.
  4. Copy the HTML when needed and keep the Markdown source in your docs or repository.

Errors you will hit

Single line breaks disappear

Standard Markdown ignores a single newline. End the line with two spaces or separate paragraphs with a blank line.

Tables or checkboxes do not render

Tables, strikethrough, and task lists are GitHub Flavored Markdown extensions. A CommonMark-only renderer shows the raw text.

Things to check

Markdown varies by platform

GitHub, blogs, and internal wikis can support different extensions, so preview again in the final publishing target.

Be careful with HTML

Published HTML depends on the target sanitizer and script restrictions. Do not publish untrusted HTML as-is.
